title: DecisionRecord
description: Redacted, stable outcome + evidence digests (ADR-0016 §3): the audit/stats/report artifact. Findings carry no field capable of holding a raw fact value — redacted by construction, not by convention (OQ-8/OQ-9). Top-level additionalProperties are allowed (ADR-0017 §9 additive-tolerant reports); nested finding/pins shapes stay closed.

findings.description: Phase-split finding collections (D-017 B2 / P3-E4-S01). Observe-phase findings land in observed; enforce-phase findings land in enforcing. Only enforcing is eligible as input to aggregation fields (decision/blocks/requiredReviews/score.total) — observe is structurally excluded, not merely by convention. Each array is a named collection keyed by (rule, subject).

observed.description: Findings from phase:observe rules — the outcome the rule would have had, recorded but unread by aggregation.

enforcing.description: Findings from phase:enforce rules — the only findings that feed decision/blocks/requiredReviews/score (ADR-0007).

obligation.description: Present only for an obligation-proving rule's finding; absent for a non-obligation effect (ADR-0017 §2).

effect.description: require-review is satisfied only by forge-proven ApprovalEvidence (ADR-0017 §3), never a bare vouch.

code.description: Stable finding code, echoing the proving rule's onFailure.code; correlated across DecisionRecord/PresentationModel.

toolDigest.description: Deterministic build-content proxy for the evaluating tool: sha256 over the binary's canonical Go build info (module path/version/sum, dependency checksums, VCS revision + dirty flag) per D-120 (OQ-9 replayability). Falls back to sha256("buildinfo-unavailable\n"+toolVersion) when build info is absent. Records emitted by pre-D-120 builds carry sha256 of toolVersion only.

mergeResultDigest.description: Evaluated merge-result digest (ADR-0017 §1). Null only when the forge capability to compute/pin it is absent, and then only alongside capabilityGap — never a silent widening of what was actually pinned.

capabilityGap.description: Present only when mergeResultDigest is null; documents which forge capability was absent (e.g. no merge-train/queue, ADR-0017 §1). Never present when mergeResultDigest was actually pinned.

factsResolvedAt.description: Keyed by provider name (ADR-0011 amendment, hermetic replay).
